# Vulkan headers

The C headers from the Khronos [Vulkan-Headers](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers)
(version 1.4.363, as shipped in the Vulkan SDK), so the runtime builds without the SDK installed.

Copyright 2015-2026 The Khronos Group Inc. Licensed under Apache-2.0 OR MIT
(`SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 OR MIT`, see the header files).

`runtime/vk_thunks.h` is generated from `include/vulkan/vulkan_core.h` by `tools/gen_vk.py`.
